lines.text: Automatic weapon detection.
Two profiles. Each with its own anti-recoil.
First, you need a DualSense controller, the one with adaptive triggers.
Then turn adaptive trigger effects on, in the game. It's the number one reason it doesn't work.
Now, turn it on. Hold L2, then release Options.
Go to the Combat category, and find the Weapon Detect row.
Make sure it's enabled. Press right on the D-pad if it isn't.
Press Cross. Set Device to PS5, and Type to Per Profile.
Press Circle to leave. You'll see saved. That's it.
Every weapon has its own trigger signature.
Fire once, and the right profile switches on its own.
Rarely, two weapons share one signature, and the screen shows a question mark.
Hold L2, Circle and Down, pick the weapon you're holding, and confirm. It remembers.
Wrong profile? One gesture fixes it.
L2 plus left restores Primary. Hold it longer to wipe and re-learn. Right does the same for Secondary.
Every weapon change is detected, matched, and applied.
No manual switching.
The full step-by-step setup guide is on Rocket Mod dot org.
